items.q: I recorded a couple of times with her. ... Like we'd play for her and that was it.

ctx.x: because you're lighter than I am." He'd say, "You're crazy." I'd lay it on him. He'd say, "Sonny, you're crazy." But we always enjoyed each other's company, you know. But it wasn't -- no one really hanged. Man, I was so busy running, me and Toby and Johnny was running crazy, man. You'd better believe it.
You ever meet Bessie Smith during those years?
I recorded a couple of times with her. But, I mean, she was very reserved. You know, she had a and like us guys, sidemen, we were sidemen. Like we'd play for her and that was it. Not socially.
